purpose: Test whether frozen 005G orderbook-state information converts into improved execution economics without changing fair-value direction.
economic_hypothesis: State and renewal hazard information may improve passive execution by reducing exposure during adverse or unstable book states and by changing quote width, size, or willingness to quote.
not_a_hypothesis: 005G relative MSE improvements equal trading returns

baseline.description: Identical replay economics with no conditioning on 005G_STATE_HAZARD_V1.

challenger_families.description: Use frozen 005G hazard information only to widen quotes in higher-hazard states.
Use frozen 005G hazard information only to reduce quote size in higher-hazard states.
Use frozen 005G hazard information only to abstain from initiating new passive exposure in the highest-hazard states.
Use frozen 005G hazard information only to alter refresh/cancel timing.
Combine only effects that individually survive the preregistered development gate.

candidate_selection_rule: subject to adverse_selection not worse than baseline
subject to max_drawdown not worse than baseline
then break ties by lower intervention rate

failure_policy.if_no_challenger_passes: 005G remains a predictive market-state result only; do not route to live execution.
failure_policy.if_only_one_component_passes: Promote only that component; do not rescue the combined policy.
failure_policy.if_holdout_fails: Do not retune on holdout and do not replace the failed challenger.

next_action_when_compute_available: Build the replay input audit, choose a disjoint economic holdout before reading economic outcomes, freeze the policy grid, then launch development replay.
